item.title: Kode 1.0.1
item.description:
A fix release, and the first one that updates itself.
## New
- **Updates.** Kode looks for a new release once a day, downloads it in the background and installs it when you quit. **Kode ▸ Check for Updates…** checks right away; **Settings ▸ Updates** turns the automatic checks off and picks the channel (stable, or stable and beta). 1.0.0 had no updater: install this release by hand once, later ones arrive on their own.
## Fixes
- **Each folder has its own session.** The files a folder's window had open are saved when it closes (and on quit) and reopen with that folder only; a folder opened for the first time starts empty, and Kode launched without a folder opens one empty window instead of every file from last time. - **Make Default** asks macOS for the common code types only, and skips those Kode already opens, so it no longer asks for a hundred extensions one by one.
